rules.statement: The next session is put on hold only once the ice has been warm for an unbroken run of at least ten minutes, measured up to the latest reading.
rules.subject: warm ice run duration

rules.statement: A temperature reading counts as warm only when it is above the warm-ice threshold. A reading at or below the threshold ends the warm run.
rules.subject: ice temperature reading

rules.statement: A warm-ice hold applies only to the earliest session that has not started yet and is not cancelled.
rules.subject: session eligible for hold

rules.statement: Only a session that is currently open can be put on hold because of warm ice.
rules.subject: session status for hold

evidence.quote: if (session.status !== "held") throw new DomainError(409, "session is not on hold");

rules.statement: A manager can cancel or release a session only while it is on hold.
rules.subject: session status for cancel or release

rules.statement: When a held session is cancelled, a paid booking is refunded through PuckPay only if its amount is above zero. Free paid entries are cancelled with no refund, and pending bookings are cancelled.
rules.subject: booking refund amount

evidence.quote: throw new DomainError(502, `could not refund all tickets: ${failures.join("; ")}`);

rules.statement: A held session becomes cancelled only after every paid ticket has been refunded. If any refund fails, the session stays on hold so the manager can retry.
rules.subject: session cancellation refunds

evidence.quote: if (this.cancelling.has(sessionId)) throw new DomainError(409, "session is already being cancelled");
if (this.cancelling.has(sessionId)) throw new DomainError(409, "session is being cancelled");

rules.statement: A session cannot be cancelled again or released while a cancellation of it is already in progress.
rules.subject: session cancellation in progress

rules.statement: Releasing a hold discards earlier temperature readings, so a fresh warm period is needed before a session can be held again.
rules.subject: warm period after release

rules.statement: When a session is put on hold, holders of paid or pending bookings who gave a phone number get a text message.
rules.subject: hold notification recipients

rules.statement: A sensor reading's temperature must be a finite number.
rules.subject: reading temperature

rules.statement: If a sensor reading includes a timestamp, it must be a finite number.
rules.subject: reading timestamp
